summary.text: Josh Cantrell is a Republican member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 49 since November 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Josh Cantrell assumed office on November 23, 2022, succeeding Tommy Hardin.
For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the Health and Human Services Oversight Committee as vice chair, and in 2023-2024 he was vice chair of the County & Municipal Government Committee.
